title: 第21章 萧天的打算第22章 南陵山脉
content_zh:
现在资源耗尽，那么补充的办法有两个，一是自己积累，二是向萧玄策开口要。
而第二种萧天不想一直用。
一来不想太过依赖萧家；二来资源数量有限，而且等级不高。
那剩下的只有第一条路可以走了。
而自己积累的话就是难度大风险高，但是收获可以是无限的。
所以萧天选择自己积累财富。
那么基本上是有三种积累财富的方式。
第一种，用实力，比如做雇佣兵，比如猎杀妖兽，比如采集药材等……
第二种，就是用脑子。
比如做生意，比如进朝为官换俸禄等……
第三种，就是靠技术。
比如炼丹，比如炼器，比如炼符等…
这当中最简单的是第一种，最复杂的是第二种，难度最大的是第三种。
第三种难度大，收益也高，这就是独特性的优势，因为只要你的技术好，就不可能被取代。
经过再三思考，萧天决定通过以第三种方式为主，加以第一种为辅的方式，快速的积累财富。
于是就问逆天珠道“前辈，有学习炼丹、炼器和炼符的方法吗？现在修炼的资源不够，我想着自己解决。”
“这些当然有了，都是小问题，不过要修炼这样法门，需要有火焰，虽然你是逆天战体，但是也不可能直接催生火焰。
所以你还是需要先找到火种，然后培养成为完全为你所用的火焰。”
逆天珠回答着
“明白了，也就是现在我需要先找到火种，然后培养成火焰，才可以炼丹和炼器等。”

萧天明白了
“对的。
当然你也可以直接把别人的火种抢过来，种在你自己的身上。
一般炼丹和炼器的修炼者都有火种。”
逆天珠继续说道。
“那被取代火种后，那个被取之人会怎样？”
萧天问道。
“火种被取走之后，那人就基本是废了，因为火种一般种在丹田，取走之后相当于在丹田上挖出一个口子，所以将不能再修炼，而且修为流逝，最后变成普通人。”
逆天珠解析道。
“这不妥，没有深仇大恨，没有必要那么残忍。
这有违我的原则。
还是找一个火种吧。”
萧天认真无比的说道。
“对了，那火种从哪里能找到呢？萧天继续追问道。
“这个不难，很多火属性的妖兽体内会有火种，我们称为妖火。
还有就是火山地脉中也有可能孕育有火种。
一般我们把在地下形成的火种称为地火。
还有就是宇宙中的恒星，经过漫长岁月的沉淀然后开始灵智，拥有强大的火焰之力，这些称为天火，天火可遇不可求。”
content_en:
Now that resources are exhausted, there are two ways to replenish them. One is to accumulate them yourself, and the other is to ask Xiao Xuance for them.
As for the second type, Xiao Tian doesn't want to use it all the time.
Firstly, they don’t want to rely too much on the Xiao family; secondly, the number of resources is limited and the level is not high.
Then the only way left is the first way.
If you accumulate it by yourself, it will be difficult and risky, but the rewards can be unlimited.
So Xiao Tian chose to accumulate wealth by himself.
So there are basically three ways to accumulate wealth.
The first is to use strength, such as being a mercenary, hunting monsters, collecting medicinal materials, etc...
The second way is to use your brain.
Such as doing business, such as entering the court to become an official in exchange for salary, etc...
The third type is to rely on technology.
For example, refining elixirs, refining weapons, refining talismans, etc...
The easiest among them is the first, the most complex is the second, and the most difficult is the third.
The third type is more difficult and more profitable. This is the advantage of uniqueness, because as long as your technology is good, it cannot be replaced.
After repeated thinking, Xiao Tian decided to quickly accumulate wealth by focusing on the third method and supplementing the first method.
So he asked Ni Tianzhu, "Senior, do you have any methods to learn how to make alchemy, weapons and talismans? There are not enough resources for cultivation now, so I want to solve it myself."
"Of course these are there, they are all minor problems, but to practice such a method, you need to have flames. Although you are a heaven-defying combat body, it is impossible to directly generate flames.
So you still need to find the fire first, and then cultivate it into a flame that works completely for you. "
Ni Tianzhu replied
"I understand, now I need to find the fire first and then cultivate it into a flame before I can refine elixirs and weapons."
Xiao Tian understood
"Right.
Of course, you can also directly steal other people’s fire and plant it in your own body.
Generally, practitioners of alchemy and weapon refining have fire. "
Ni Tianzhu continued.
"Then after the fire is replaced, what will happen to the person who was taken from it?"
Xiao Tian asked.
"After the fire is taken away, that person is basically useless, because the fire is usually planted in the Dantian, and taking it away is equivalent to digging a hole in the Dantian, so he will no longer be able to practice, and his cultivation will pass, and he will eventually become an ordinary person."
Ni Tianzhu analyzed.
"This is inappropriate, there is no deep hatred, there is no need to be so cruel.
This goes against my principles.
Just find a fire starter. "
Xiao Tian said extremely seriously.
"By the way, where can I find the fire? Xiao Tian continued to ask.
"This is not difficult. Many fire-attribute monsters have fire in their bodies, which we call monster fire.
There is also the possibility that fire is bred in volcanic leylines.
Generally, we call the fire formed underground as underground fire.
There are also stars in the universe. After long years of precipitation, they begin to become intelligent and possess powerful fire power. These are called heavenly fires. Heavenly fires can only be encountered but not sought. "
